newsitem.title: USA: Russian defense minister begins U.S. talks.
newsitem.headline: Russian defense minister begins U.S. talks.

text.p: Russian Defence Minister Igor Rodionov on Tuesday began two days of talks with senior U.S. officials aimed at improving bilateral military ties despite Moscow's opposition to NATO enlargement in Europe.

Rodionov was welcomed to the Pentagon by Defence Secretary William Cohen, where officials said they would discuss issues ranging from increased military cooperation to nuclear arms cuts and security in Europe and the Pacific.

The defence leaders were to hold a news conference before Rodionov met later on Tuesday with White House National Security Adviser Samuel Berger. He will meet on Wednesday with Secretary of State Madeleine Albright before departing for Hawaii and Japan.

Rodionov and Cohen chatted briefly in front of cameras in Cohen's office before reporters were ushered out. That followed a colourful welcoming ceremony and 19-gun salute for the visitor on the grassy Pentagon parade field.

Rodionov, a now-retired general who replaced Pavel Grachev as defence minister last year, stopped as he walked by the U.S. flag on the parade ground. He faced the flag and its military bearer and bowed slightly before he and Cohen continued reviewing the military honour guard.

The visit was Rodionov's first to Washington as defence minister and came as Russian President Boris Yeltsin stepped up his personal telephone diplomacy with NATO leaders on Tuesday but told his top negotiator to take a tough line in talks with the western alliance on its plans for enlargement.
